YellowPages Middlesex NJ category pages (via search results; direct fetch blocked)

categories_thin: Veterinarians - only one clinic (Bound Brook Veterinary Clinic) found in the borough; likely genuinely just one.
Optometrists - only two found; plausible for a 3.5 sq mi borough.
Title agencies and escrow - none located inside Middlesex Borough; the registered title companies found were in Piscataway and New Brunswick.
Staffing - only two found, both single-directory listings.

Property management and real estate brokerages - surprisingly thin (Emess, Forte, and two small brokerages); most 08846 agents appear to hang their license at offices in Bound Brook, Piscataway or Dunellen.
caveats: Excluded national/regional brands and franchise locations found during research: Century 21 Van Syckel Golden Post (franchise brokerage), Edward Jones (Paul McFadden), Thrivent (Ronald Kovac), Merrill/Bank of America, Somerset Savings Bank, Unity Bank, Wells Fargo, Advanced Dentistry - A Dental365 Company, Camp Bow Wow Middlesex, HearingLife.
Excluded RWJPE Primary Care Center of Middlesex (530 Union Ave) as part of a large health system, per the brief's exclusion for hospitals and large health systems.
Flagged for triage because they may be regional brands rather than one-site independents: Evenly Orthodontics, BEST Physical Therapy, Inspire Physical Therapy, Advocare Mehta Pediatrics.

Several businesses sit in shared office suites (495 Union Ave, 147 Union Ave, 141 Union Ave, 601 Bound Brook Rd, 1273 Bound Brook Rd); these suites are typical of the borough and may house more firms than any directory lists.
Middlesex Family Dental appears with two different phone numbers across directories (own website: 732-926-1234).
Some address strings are exactly as the directory published them (including '27 Hamiltonian Apartments') and were not corrected.
data_gaps: YellowPages, SuperPages, Manta, Justia, BBB, ChamberOfCommerce.com, Opendi, Cylex, Loc8NearMe category pages, ADA Find-a-Dentist and Booksy list pages all returned HTTP 403 or JS-only content to direct fetches. Their data here comes from search-engine result summaries, so those entries are less reliable than ones whose own site rendered.

Google Maps / Bing Maps were not available to this task (the brief provided no browser tools), so no map-based sweep of the borough was possible; a map pass would likely surface several more small offices, especially along Union Ave and Bound Brook Rd.

Solo mental-health practitioners listed individually on Psychology Today for 08846 (roughly 15-20 profiles) were not enumerated; only named group practices were listed, to avoid publishing what may be individuals' home offices.
No official Borough of Middlesex business directory or licensed-business list was found; the borough website's community directory is described as under construction.
Home-based businesses that appear only at residential street addresses in bulk directories were deliberately omitted under the home-address rule.
